noun_definition: Workspace refers to a collaborative environment within the application where members can be added or removed and settings can be managed.
Member refers to an individual added to a workspace who can be managed through the workspace settings.
Modal refers to the dialog box that appears when attempting to remove a member from a workspace, which incorrectly indicates the user's approval status.
User refers to an individual member of a workspace who may or may not have the role of an approver within the workspace settings.

Approver refers to a user who has the authority to approve actions within the workspace, and in this Issue, it highlights the incorrect display of a user's status as an approver in the "Remove member" modal when they do not actually hold that status.
